description: Unit tests for the FilterSourceStream class and its subclasses, testing data filtering, chaining, error handling, and read behaviors in the net namespace.

classes.name: TestFilterSourceStreamBase
classes.description: Base class for testing FilterSourceStream subclasses, providing buffer management and type string handling.

classes.name: NeedsAllInputFilterSourceStream
classes.description: FilterSourceStream that requires all input data before returning non-zero bytes.

classes.name: MultiplySourceStream
classes.description: FilterSourceStream that repeats each input byte by a specified multiplier.

classes.name: PassThroughFilterSourceStream
classes.description: FilterSourceStream that passes data through unchanged.

classes.name: ThrottleSourceStream
classes.description: FilterSourceStream that throttles output to one byte at a time.

classes.name: NoOutputSourceStream
classes.description: FilterSourceStream that consumes all input but produces no output.

classes.name: ErrorFilterSourceStream
classes.description: FilterSourceStream that returns an error in FilterData.

classes.name: FilterSourceStreamTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for parameterized tests of FilterSourceStream behaviors.

methods.name: WriteBufferToOutput
methods.description: Copies data from internal buffer to output buffer, returns number of bytes written.

methods.name: FilterData
methods.description: Virtual method overridden by subclasses to filter data.

methods.name: GetTypeAsString
methods.description: Returns the string representing the type of the stream.

methods.name: set_type_string
methods.description: Sets the type string for the stream.

methods.name: Consumed_all_input
methods.description: Indicates whether all input has been consumed.

methods.name: Description
methods.description: Returns a string describing the filter chain.
